body:
it's not about being defensive. My concerns when writing this were:
1. having clear error messages: if you don't do this you get `TypeError: Cannot read property 'AlgoliaAnalyticsObject' of null`, which doesn't say much about what happened. 
2. not deceiving the reader thinking such a line can't fail `typeof window !== 'undefined' && window. AlgoliaAnalyticsObject`:
  Maybe writing it as `typeof window !== 'undefined' && window !== null` would have been better. 
  Or we can decide the window global can't be null, which is a safe assumption to my knowledge.
